Preconditions: A shop and an item with text measurement parameters are already created in the system
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the measurement parameter with textValue: {"nameEn": "Special Notes", "nameBn": "বিশেষ নোট", "type": "TEXT", "textValue": "Extra stitching on collar"}.

Title: Attempt to create an order referencing a non-existent item ID
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists in the system
Expected Result: The system rejects the order creation request and returns a response payload with status 'error' and message 'An unexpected error occurred:Item not found with ID: 99999'.

Title: Attempt to create an order referencing a non-existent shop ID
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/orders with the JSON payload provided in testData.

Test Data: {
  "shopId": 88888,
  "customerName": "Jane Doe",
  "customerPhone": "01800000000",
  "customerGender": "FEMALE",
  "paidAmount": 0,
  "items": []
}
Expected Result: The system rejects the order creation request and returns a response payload with status 'error' and message 'An unexpected error occurred:Shop not found with ID: 88888'.

Title: Create an order with items parameter set to null
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists in the system
Steps:

Test Data: {
  "shopId": 1,
  "customerName": "John Doe",
  "customerPhone": "01700000000",
  "paidAmount": 0,
  "items": null
}
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK status code is returned with status 'success', and the order is created with no order items and total amount of 0.00.

Title: Create an order item with measurementGroups set to null

Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK status code is returned with status 'success', creating the order successfully with no measurement groups attached to item 10.

Title: Verify that unexpected errors in order processing expose internal exception details in the API response message
Section: Order Management - Sensitive Data Exposure in Error Handling
Preconditions: The application service is running and accessible.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/orders with the JSON payload provided in testData containing an invalid date format for trialDate.

Test Data: {
  "shopId": 1,
  "customerName": "John Doe",
  "customerPhone": "01700000000",
  "customerGender": "MALE",
  "paidAmount": 100,
  "trialDate": "invalid-date-format",
  "deliveryDate": "2026-12-31",
  "items": []
}
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 200 (OK) or 500 containing a JSON body where status is 'error' and the 'message' field explicitly includes the internal exception message string prefixed with 'An unexpected error occurred:' (e.g., 'An unexpected error occurred:Text 'invalid-date-format' could not be parsed').
